reason: Recharging the cold packs directly addresses the transfer reserve and protects the discovery during later transport.
expectation: The powered freezer will restore the packs' ability to absorb heat, though I don't know whether more preparation will be needed.

alternatives.reason: Restarting fuel production also addresses a goal, but I want to secure the cold reserve first.

effect: The flight packs are reconditioned and the cold-transfer goal is complete, so I can turn to production.
reaction: A straightforward, reassuring result, though it adds little beyond what I expected.
reason: The remaining numbered action connects restored power to the plant controls, matching the remaining goal.
expectation: The propellant plant will restart and begin replacing losses; I am unsure whether it will need further steps.

effect: The return plant is running and both goals are complete; no further work is requested in this chapter.
reaction: It is satisfying to restore the plant after the storm, though the restart itself is very quick.

mostWorthwhile.text: Restarting the return plant tied restored solar power to replacing propellant lost through boil-off, giving the recovery a concrete purpose.

leastWorthwhile.text: Reconditioning the packs was a predictable single operation with no new detail in its result; it felt more like a checklist than a discovery.

surprise.text: Nothing in these two results particularly surprised me; both matched the clearly stated goals.

arbitrary.text: Neither action felt arbitrary: a freezer recharges cold packs and power at restart controls starts the plant. Both were explicit, straightforward matches.

continue.text: Yes, I would continue to see how the preserved body gets home, although this brief maintenance chapter itself offered little decision-making or new discovery.
